changes.three_level_information_test: Only information capable of reversing grant/deny permits necessita_informacao; useful detail and already summarized evidence no longer block direction.
changes.directional_monetary_grant: A monetary request may be granted with valor_centavos=null only when responsibility is supported and the remaining gap is value or proportion.
changes.summary_as_evidence: Do not demand originals merely because the IC receives summaries; apply the described evidence while never inventing unseen contents.
changes.minimum_support: Unsupported constitutive allegations may be denied on the current record, while specific summarized documentary support is not neutralized by a generic defense.
changes.non_monetary_execution: Useful details about timing or implementation do not prevent deciding the requested obligation itself.

success_conditions: materially reduce avoidable abstentions in the first 25 cases
preserve necessita_informacao when the audit found decisive information absent
do not regress the ten fully resolved controls
produce valid leader panels and no invented monetary values
